en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a small railway yard and tracks stretching into the distance through a rural settlement. A steam train is visible on the central track, with houses and trees on either side and a water tower in the background. In the foreground are side tracks, a freight wagon, stacked rails or timber, and a person standing near the fence. Printed caption text appears along the bottom left, and a number is printed at the lower right.
